purpose.domain_detail: AMBEV (Brazilian beverage company) client and salesperson registration system with CRUD operations and reporting
purpose.summary: PROGMENU is an interactive menu-driven program for managing clients (CLIENTE) and salespeople (VENDEDOR) for AMBEV. It presents a main menu with options for registrations, reports, and execution, and delegates CRUD operations to subprograms CRUDCLIE and CRUDVEND via CALL statements. The program uses a SCREEN SECTION for full-screen terminal interaction.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with full-screen terminal UI (BLANK SCREEN, LINE/COL, TO/FROM/USING AUTO)
88-level condition names for CRUD operation types
CALL to external subprograms CRUDCLIE and CRUDVEND
Latitude/longitude fields (geolocation data for clients and salespeople)
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
